title: 第17章 武道宗师第18章 书房密谈
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 真气不仅能长时间离体攻击，威力倍增，更能初步与神魂交融，产生灵觉，洞察周遭细微变化，感知危险，甚至能引动一丝天地之势，加持己身。
仿佛天地初开的一声巨响，在方云逸的体内深处炸开。那层困扰他一年之久的壁垒，在浩瀚紫气冲击下，轰然破碎。
刹那间，他体内原本如同雾气般的紫色元气急剧收缩、凝聚，最终化为一股更加凝实、更加灵动、蕴含着的紫色液体。
这正是武道宗师境标志性的真气！
他周身毛孔舒张，一股强横的气息不受控制地弥漫开来，却又被剑塔空间牢牢束缚在内。
方云逸的五感在这一刻变得前所未有的敏锐，即使闭着眼睛，也能“看”到塔内紫气流动的轨迹。
甚至隐隐感知到塔外现实世界中，福伯正在厨房那边忙碌着的脚步声。
筋骨齐鸣，血液奔流如汞！一种脱胎换骨、力量充盈的感觉充斥全身。
原本徐长老造成的暗伤，在这突破的瞬间，被澎湃的真气和紫气彻底修复，甚至经脉比受伤前更加宽阔、坚韧。
十五岁的武道宗师！方云逸缓缓睁开双眼，眸中紫电一闪而逝。
据他所知，在这苍玄大陆有明确记载的历史中，能在四十岁前突破宗师者，已是凤毛麟角，被视为绝世天才。
而他，年仅十五！
这其中，固然有着他两世为人心志坚韧、厚积薄发的缘故，但更重要的，是脑海中这座神秘剑塔和《紫霄剑经》的逆天功效。
没有这八年紫气日夜不停的滋养和淬炼，没有这无上功法的引导，他绝无可能打破这年龄的极限。
就在他成功突破至宗师境，体内紫色真气稳固运行的刹那，异变再生！
只见剑塔第一层的中央，那原本悬浮着《紫霄剑经》初卷文字的地方，空间一阵扭曲。
一道由纯粹紫光构成的螺旋阶梯，缓缓浮现，向上延伸，通往那之前无论如何都无法触及的第二层。
“果然！”方云逸心中激动。
“这是需要《紫霄剑经》第一层心法圆满，再配合相应的武道境界，才能开启的下一层。”
他在这第一层心法上四年前便已达到圆满，只因修为卡在武师境，才迟迟无法打开第二层。
方云逸按捺住心中的期待，迈步踏上紫色阶梯。阶梯看似虚幻，踩上去却坚实无比。
一步步向上，仿佛穿越无形的屏障。
当他落下最后一脚，眼前豁然开朗！
剑塔第二层的空间，比第一层要广阔数倍不止。这里的紫气更加浓郁，几乎化为实质。
深吸一口，顿时便感觉到整个人都神清气爽，体内真气活跃。
但更引人注目的是，在这浓郁的紫气之中，还混杂着一缕缕如同星辉般的银色气流和一丝丝充满生命气息的青色流光。
“这是……星辰精华？还有乙木生机之气？”方云逸根据阅读过的典籍猜测道。
content_en:
Not only can the true energy be separated from the body for a long time to attack, the power is doubled, but it can also initially blend with the soul, generate spiritual awareness, perceive subtle changes in the surroundings, sense danger, and even induce a trace of the power of heaven and earth to bless one's body.
"Boom——!"
A loud noise, like the opening of heaven and earth, exploded deep inside Fang Yunyi's body. The barrier that had troubled him for a year shattered under the impact of the vast purple energy.
In an instant, the mist-like purple energy in his body shrank and condensed sharply, and finally turned into a more solid, more agile, and contained purple liquid.
This is the iconic true energy of the martial arts master realm!
The pores all over his body dilated, and a powerful aura spread out uncontrollably, but was firmly restrained by the sword tower space.
Fang Yunyi's five senses became more acute than ever at this moment. Even with his eyes closed, he could "see" the trajectory of the purple air flowing in the tower.
He even faintly sensed the footsteps of Fu Bo who was busy in the kitchen in the real world outside the tower.
The muscles and bones roar together, and the blood rushes like mercury! A feeling of renewal and strength filled the whole body.
The hidden injury originally caused by Elder Xu was completely repaired by the surging true energy and purple energy at this moment of breakthrough, and the meridians were even wider and tougher than before the injury.
Fifteen-year-old martial arts master! Fang Yunyi slowly opened his eyes, and purple lightning flashed in his eyes.
As far as he knew, in the clearly recorded history of Cangxuan Continent, those who could break through to master level before the age of forty were already very rare and were regarded as peerless geniuses.
And he is only fifteen years old!
Of course, this is due to his tenacity and accumulation of experience in his two lives, but more importantly, it is the heaven-defying effect of this mysterious sword tower and the "Purple Sky Sword Sutra" in his mind.
Without the eight years of constant nourishment and tempering of the purple energy day and night, and without the guidance of this supreme technique, he would never have been able to break the age limit.
The moment he successfully broke through to the Grandmaster realm and the purple true energy in his body was running steadily, the mutation regenerated!
I saw that in the center of the first floor of the sword tower, where the first volume of the "Purple Sky Sword Sutra" was originally suspended, the space was distorted.
A spiral staircase composed of pure purple light slowly emerged, extending upward, leading to the second level that was previously untouchable.
"Sure enough!" Fang Yunyi was excited.
"This is the next level that requires the completion of the first level of the "Purple Sky Sword Sutra" and the corresponding martial arts realm."
He had reached perfection in this first level of mental skills four years ago. It was only because his cultivation was stuck at the martial master level that he was unable to open the second level.
Fang Yunyi suppressed the expectations in her heart and stepped onto the purple stairs. The stairs may seem illusory, but they are extremely solid when you step on them.
Step by step upward, as if crossing an invisible barrier.
When he landed the last kick, his eyes suddenly opened up!
The space on the second floor of the sword tower is several times wider than the first floor. The purple energy here is even more intense, almost turning into substance.
After taking a deep breath, I immediately felt that my whole body was refreshed and the true energy in my body was active.
But what is even more eye-catching is that in this rich purple air, there are also wisps of silver airflow like stars and traces of cyan light full of life.
"Is this... the essence of the stars? And the vitality of Yimu?" Fang Yunyi guessed based on the classics he had read.
